title: does anyone else have a post apocalyptic mall world?
content: Everyone seems to have populated worlds that have a beach of some sort and stuff is wacky and silly. Mine is none of those. Mine is abandoned, grimy, and dangerous. The closest I can describe the aesthetic is like fallout, but there’s no monsters, no people, nothing. It’s just me. Occasionally there will be other people, but they’re always a focus point of the story. I don’t have background characters. It’s land locked. I have a forest with a lake cabin. No other water except for the 2 parallel long narrow pools in a section of the mall. There’s also no lights in the mall. The stores are empty. There’s no bathroom, so no infinite toilets. I’ve seen a lot of people with a movie theater and stuff. I don’t have that. I just have a grimy red light bar/strip club combo. There’s broken down roads and sand if you go far enough. When you go far enough through the desert portion there’s an abandoned stereotypical american diner. On the opposite end of that near the mall there is an abandoned grocery store/pharmacy combo. There’s a prison near there at an unknown location. There’s also the suburbs where no one lives except for a man patrolling the streets with a gun. He’s dangerous. There’s 3 schools that I have no idea if they’re in this same location or not. I think at least one is. Edit: Stuff I forgot to add: There’s the fever dream version of the house I lived in from ages 11-18 and then the house I live in now. Then there’s just this random house. No idea where they are relative to everything else. There’s a city somewhere, I don’t know how to get there unless the dream starts there. It’s not falling apart. it’s very clean and modern, but it houses no people. I have a very nice pent house there at least. In the mall there’s a indoor park(?) that consists of an insanely high tower, at least 100 feet, with a rope that you’re meant to climb. There is no safety features. No harnesses, the floor is hard rubber, no safety mats. Once you climb the rope there’s a bridge that is just 3 thin square platforms held up by 4 ropes one on each corner. They shake when you stand on them. On the other end of the bridge there’s another 100ft tower. I’ve never made it past the bridge part, I only ever got to go there once and I fell off and died. There’s functioning internet in my dreams and the reviews for this place are really funny to me. It has a 2 or 3 star rating rating and it’s just people saying “yeah I died there once.” There’s news articles on the deaths that happen there too. The park never faced legal actions for the deaths. It’s still open according to the internet there.
